title: Level Completion Softlock Due to Unresponsive Portal Transition
explanation: Between frames 1440 and 1554, the player entered the level terminus at (7410, 160) and overlapped the portal collision shape across 46 frames, but no portal_entered or scene transition was triggered. Traced to Portal2D.gd:L14 / Portal2D.tscn where collision_layer is 0 and the node failed to register in the portals group, soft-locking progression.
